title: n8n-io/n8n
claim: n8n-io/n8n — Fair-code workflow automation platform with native AI capabilities. Combine visual building with custom code, self-host
why_good: n8n's fair-code model allows businesses to customize their automation solutions without the constraints of traditional SaaS licensing.
value: Companies can pay for premium support, additional features, or hosted solutions, creating a recurring revenue stream.
risk: The market for workflow automation is crowded, and larger players could easily integrate similar features, overshadowing n8n's offering.
